title: Price Band Adjustment to Builder Extended Rate Lock Locked Rates
content:
The contract price of the home places a Builder Extended Rate Lock in a price band that may move its locked rate.

**Band rule.** Where the Home Purchase Agreement's contract price is above USD 500000, 0.0625 points come off the rate; where it is below USD 300000, 0.125 points are added; otherwise nothing changes. The points are percentage points of interest rate, applied to the locked rate before it is held at no less than the par rate and rounded.

| Contract price on the Home Purchase Agreement | Locked rate |
|---|---|
| below USD 300000 | 0.125 points added |
| USD 300000 up to and including USD 500000 | no change |
| above USD 500000 | 0.0625 points off |

The contract price is read from the Home Purchase Agreement record of the agreement the lock finances.

## Edges (hypothetical prices)

- USD 299999.00: below USD 300000, 0.125 added.
- USD 300000.00 and USD 500000.00: inside the middle band, no change.
- USD 500000.01: above USD 500000, 0.0625 off.
